dashboard.description: Ownership, contract and simulated-capacity view for the B300 prelab. SIMULATED metrics are labelled as such: nothing here is evidence about real GPU health, which is HW-03 on delivered hardware.

panels.description: Must be 0 at all times. Any other value means Kubernetes and VAST may both believe they own a node — a P0 incident, not a graph to watch trend.
panels.title: Nodes violating single-owner

panels.description: Nodes serving a paying rental. Reclaim is hard-blocked while this is non-zero; unlist does not reclaim.
panels.title: Nodes with active contracts

panels.description: SIMULATED. Expected 32 (4 nodes x 8). This says nothing about real GPU health.
panels.title: Simulated GPU healthy

panels.description: Sustained non-zero means ownership is drifting from desired state.
panels.title: Controller reconcile errors (5m)

panels.description: Each node must have exactly one series at 1 at any instant. Two overlapping series at 1 is the dual-ownership failure this whole system exists to prevent.
panels.title: Owner over time (1 = owns the node)

panels.description: While this is above zero for a node, that node may not be sanitized, uncordoned or returned to ARISE.
panels.title: Active contracts per node

panels.description: Drops when a device is marked unhealthy through the fault-injection endpoint. On real hardware this maps to DCGM/Xid — a different, harder test (HW-03).
panels.title: Simulated GPU capacity per node (SIMULATED)

panels.description: Drift corrections and gate refusals. A rising OwnerDrift or IsolationDrift line means something outside the controller is editing node state.
panels.title: Policy denials by reason
